messages:
Sam: FYI we're scheduling a header-split switch (router -> runtime) during tomorrow's change window 2024-07-05 10:30 UTC. Need cross-service sync: API flagging, runtime image pin, console optional fields. Plan to use deploy-bot phased canary. Any objections?

Maria: Runtime is pinned to redwood/runtime:v2.3.1 for the rollout. Note: KV eviction tightened by default which can transiently increase misses on cold pods. Console will treat new route headers as optional.

Li: Console PR merged (console-bff#541). Backwards-compatible: if route metadata missing we fall back to legacy display. Canaries starting now for console.

Jin: API: header-steering flag ready. Proposed traffic schedule: 1% -> 20% -> 100%. Rollback thresholds: p95 latency > 200ms or errors > 0.5% for two consecutive 5-minute windows. If triggered, flip flag off and invoke router pin.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Initiating canary session cb-20240705-02. Targets: api-canary, console-canary, runtime-canary, router-canary. Monitor at /deploy/cb-20240705-02.

Maria: Note: expect brief error blips (2-3%) during KV warmup on first pods. Suggest a hold after reaching 20% for 10 minutes to confirm stabilization before continuing.

Jin: Agreed. Add automatic hold: if error-rate > 0.5% or p95 > 200ms during the hold for two consecutive 5m windows, rollback. Playbook has detailed rollback steps and alert routing to #incidents.

Li: I added temporary console alerts: route-change error > 0.5% alerts paging and created a dashboard tile for per-variant traces.

Sam: I'll draft release notes: runtime: default KV warmup tweak; console: new optional route metadata; api: header routing flag + rollback command examples. Anything else?

Eve: Please include the router-pin curl snippet for SREs: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/router/pin -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"variant":"legacy","reason":"rollback"}'`. Also include the ops smoke script path.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary wave1 finished (10m). No threshold breaches. Proceeding to wave2 -> 20%.

Maria: Observability: p50 +10ms during warmup, p95 steady, error-rate within tolerance. Holding at 20% for 10m now.

Jin: If hold stable for 15m total, we'll advance to full. @Sam prepare final release note publish and add post-deploy retrospective item about caching.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Wave2 hold passed (15m). Progressing to 100%. Running post-deploy smoke: `/ops/smoke/check_routes.sh`.

Sam: All green on smoke so far. I'll publish release notes and close this thread once we confirm 1h of stability. :tada:

Li: Dashboards left open, will alert if any regressions.

Maria: Marking runtime as pinned to v2.3.1 for the record.

Sam: Final: rollout complete, no rollback, metrics stable. Will add a brief retrospective tomorrow. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
